name: High Rise
summary: The High Rise gathers Thunder Bluff's tribes around its central fire, high above Mulgore.

sections.title: Summit of the Mesa
sections.body: At Thunder Bluff's summit, the High Rise catches the open winds above Mulgore's rolling plains. Tauren gather in its open-air amphitheater around a fire pit to hear tribal announcements and witness decisions. Tents and wooden stalls hold merchants, armories, and culinary trainers, including Aska's Kitchen and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle. The lower tiers reach Mulgore's prairie floor by massive wooden elevators, but no elevator connects the plains to the High Rise. The wind rider roost and rope bridges to Elder Rise and Hunter Rise provide the way up.

faq.q: How do you reach the High Rise?
aliases: how to get to high rise
faq.answer: Reach the High Rise from the lower tiers through the central wind rider roost, or cross a suspension bridge from Elder Rise or Hunter Rise. No lift runs directly from the Mulgore plains to this tier.

faq.q: What services are found on the High Rise?
faq.answer: The High Rise has tradesfolk and outdoor gathering places. Aska's Kitchen teaches cooking, Mountaintop Bait & Tackle sells fishing gear, and Ragetotem Arms and Thunderhoof's Firearms are among its weapon merchants.

faq.q: What is the amphitheater on the High Rise used for?
faq.answer: The open-air amphitheater gathers the tauren around a central bonfire. They hear news, deliberate tribal affairs, and witness important proclamations atop the mesa.

angles.text: At Aska's Kitchen on the High Rise, you can hone your cooking skills with the renowned pit masters over an open flame. It is Thunder Bluff's main place for learning the craft.
As a tauren, you see the High Rise crown your capital and unite the tribes. Hunters, shamans, and elders gather around its high communal fire.
